observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a dark grey foldable smartphone with a vertical triple-camera module, flash, pink sticker, and a 'Made in Korea' label at the bottom.
Photo 1 shows the inner main screen folded open; the screen is dark with visible vertical scratches, scuffs, and smudges across the display.
Both photos carry a 'POSTED ON JIJI DEETECH GADGETZ' watermark.
No brand name, model number, or storage capacity is readable in either photo.

claims.evidence: No model name or storage marking is visible in the photos; only a 'Made in Korea' label can be read.

risks.risk: Device may not power on or function (motherboard, hinge, cameras, speakers).
risks.proof: Video of the phone booting, navigating menus, and testing cameras, hinge, and speakers.

risks.risk: It may not be a Samsung Z Fold 4 or 512gb variant; could be an older model, different storage, or misrepresented.
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > About phone showing model number and storage capacity.
risks.if_unproven: as an unverified lower-spec foldable smartphone

risks.risk: Inner screen may have dead pixels, touch issues, or display faults beyond the visible scratches.
risks.proof: Video of the inner screen powered on showing full display and touch response across the crease.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or non-original.
risks.proof: Screenshot of battery health or a video showing charge percentage over time.

proof_requests: Screenshot of Settings > About phone showing model and storage
Video of the inner screen powered on with touch test across the crease
Video showing boot-up, cameras, and hinge operation
Photo of the IMEI/serial number label
response.reason: It is identifiable as a foldable smartphone with visible inner-screen damage; the model and storage claims cannot be verified from the photos, so it is priced at worst case as a non-working, damaged foldable phone.
